tradeoffs: A bounded producer queue plus code dictionary moves serialization/storage away from application callbacks at a measured2176KiB peak RSS increase in the 10k-call fixture; no samples were dropped in before/after comparison.
One project registration per run and bounded per-run source indexes avoid a global process registry rewrite on every interpreter.
Complete-prefix CLI conversion uses bounded disk scratch instead of retaining all Python events; limits fail atomically and never claim an exported complete recording after truncation.
Version-shared caches are retained conservatively for detached descendants; cleanup removes stale completed wrappers rather than guessing that cached code is unused.
Bounded pre-fork quiescing prevents a stalled NFS writer turning a fork into an unbounded wait; active capture remains multithreaded and the warning remains visible.
